translation: Slightly cold, poisonous. It treats blood from vomiting that does not leave the chest and abdomen (吐血在胸腹不去), and breaks bone [fractures] and ligament [injuries] (破骨[blank]折), blood-knotting (血結), metal wounds with internal blockage (金瘡內塞), postpartum cold in the center (產後中寒), and bringing down breast milk (下乳). One name is [blank] chuqi (楚齊), one name is Boqi (㪍齊). It grows in Henei and in heaps of accumulated dung and grass in people's [homes].
